He is one of the world's leading art critics, all of his books are excellent, and he has a new and very good work coming out titled [Vermeer: A Life Lost and Found](https://marginalrevolution.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=f33354e9d7aeacedf7e9542a3f5ac9d9ed7d633672c7d44b6d6efeb34df8b3db&blog_id=42693868&post_id=92710&user_id=262258391&subs_id=225460721&signature=549990dd1aa109885ee3d7559b755dee&email_name=new-post&user_email=ishan.mail@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=7557e71cd4725b381c4256741fd94eb4). He also has a well-known book on Caravaggio, on Michelangelo, and I am especially fond of his book on British art.
